02 / THE HUMAN BEHIND THE CODE

Developer by passion.
Dad at heart.

My favorite things in life
aren’t all on a screen.

I’m Tony — a family man, a father of two, and someone who really, really loves developing.

I’m a proud Purdue Boilermaker grad, now living in Florida. My curiosity didn’t end at graduation — there’s always something new to learn, try, or build.

I get a kick out of turning an idea into something you can actually use. Sometimes that means a new tool. Sometimes it means a vault of dad jokes. There’s always something worth exploring.

Family is at the center of it all. Two kids keep life full of surprises, and remind me there’s plenty of wonder in the everyday, too.
